title: IFC/BCF/IDS and file interoperability
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product with a bounded interoperability layer covering IFC, IDS, BCF, DXF/DWG boundaries, PDF/SVG plotting/export and legally compatible archival formats while preserving ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: IFC import/export and round-trip preserve supported canonical semantics, identities/provenance and documentation relationships deterministically.
IDS validation is explicit, deterministic and reports structured pass/fail results without creating a parallel source of truth.
BCF issue exchange preserves supported references, viewpoints and source lineage with explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes where needed.
DXF/DWG interoperability is implemented only within the approved boundary; unsupported features fail explicitly rather than fabricating semantics.
PDF/SVG plotting/export produces deterministic artifacts from the existing documentation/plot IR without replacing the renderer architecture.
Native archival formats are supported only where legally compatible and architecturally bounded.
Web and Electron share the same interoperability contracts and canonical results.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..013, COMPAT-CAD-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 fixtures remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is necessary.
Real engine/toolchain behavior remains behind the existing adapter/worker boundary.
The exact final implementation head is CI-verified, deployment-verified where applicable, browser/Electron verified and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: Replacing the CAD renderer or geometry engine.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-013 is VERIFIED and is the current documentation-production baseline.
COMPAT-IFC-001 is VERIFIED and remains the IFC exchange baseline.
COMPAT-CAD-003 remains available as the compatibility baseline.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P014.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic IFC/IDS/BCF and supported file-format import/export tests.
Round-trip fixtures with canonical identity/provenance checks and explicit loss classification.
Web/Electron semantic parity fixtures for representative interoperability workflows.
Real OCCT/IFC toolchain evidence through existing adapter/worker boundaries.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..013 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Release CAD-PARITY-014 as the bounded interoperability phase following verified documentation production.
All declared P014 dependencies are verified on main. Assign implementation to the logical implementation agent and require stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.
